skills.title: Accessible Interface
skills.description: Design and review inclusive interfaces for keyboard, screen-reader, cognitive, and visual access.

skills.title: Color and Contrast
skills.description: Build purposeful interface color roles with legible contrast, clear states, and restrained emphasis.

skills.title: Design Context
skills.description: Capture the product, users, constraints, and design direction before making interface decisions.

skills.title: Layout and Spacing
skills.description: Create coherent interface layouts and spacing systems that preserve relationships across screen sizes.

skills.title: Typography
skills.description: Choose and tune interface typography for readable hierarchy, rhythm, density, and resilient content.

skills.title: Visual Hierarchy
skills.description: Strengthen interface hierarchy so attention, reading order, and primary actions are immediately clear.
